subject: environmental-science
title: Water in the Environment: Clean Water for All
welcome_lead: Treating water makes it safe to drink — and used water needs cleaning too.
meta_desc: KS3 environmental science: water treatment, pipes, sewage.
final_note: Clean water is a quiet miracle of engineering.

concepts.def: Place that cleans water for drinking.
Long period with too little rain.

walkthroughs.body_html: Water from rivers and reservoirs goes through a treatment plant: settling, filtering and disinfecting with chlorine or UV.
Sewage from houses runs through pipes to sewage works. Bacteria break down waste before treated water returns to rivers.
Long droughts empty reservoirs. Saving water at home (short showers, fixing drips) helps everyone.

mcqs.q: What is the difference between ozone depletion and climate change?
options: Two distinct issues - ozone depletion is about UV protection (caused mainly by CFCs); climate change is about heat trapping (caused mainly by CO2).
Ozone depletion causes climate change directly.
